_meta.what_this_is: A tiny 2D vector index for approximate nearest-neighbor (ANN) retrieval. Documents live in three clusters; each is assigned to its nearest centroid, which is how an IVF-style index buckets vectors. A query is answered by probing only the nprobe centroids nearest the query and searching the documents in those buckets -- fast, but it can miss a document that sits near a cluster boundary in a bucket the query did not probe. Exhaustive search checks every document and always finds the true nearest.
_meta.data_is: A FIXTURE. The centroids, document positions, and queries are hand-placed in 2D so that two of the five queries have their true nearest document one bucket away -- the exact boundary case ANN misses at nprobe=1 and recovers at nprobe=2. Every distance, assignment, and recall is computed in search.py.
_meta.format: centroids: {name:[x,y]}; docs: {id:[x,y]}; queries: {id:[x,y]}. Distances are Euclidean.
